# FG-DEPLOY-0003

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`deploy`](../../ops/runbooks/deploy.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_unreachable_target_fails_the_deployment` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: デプロイ先のサーバーに接続できませんでした。管理者に問い合わせ番号を伝えてください。
- en: The deployment target server could not be reached. Give the request ID to the administrator.
- id: Server tujuan deployment tidak dapat dijangkau. Berikan ID permintaan kepada administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 (ADR-0031 decision 3): ssh to a target failed: before the remote script ran (`reason` refused / timed_out / dns / auth / network / spawn: the connection never opened, the target is unchanged) or with the connection lost after it opened (`connection_lost`: ssh exited 255 with no message that proves it never opened; the script may have run, so the target counts as changed and is rolled back on an environment with `auto_rollback`). The deployment fails (`failed`, or `rolled_back`).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs `forge.deploy.target_failed` (error) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `deployment_id`, `target`, `host`, `port`, `step` (`deploy` / `health` / `rollback`) and `reason` (`connect` / `timeout` / `spawn`); ssh's own messages are not logged. Reproduce from the forge host: ssh -F none -i <deploy.ssh_key_file> -o BatchMode=yes -p <port> -l <user> -- <host> true. `forge doctor` (deploy.known_hosts) lists every target with its pinned fingerprint.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook deploy (Unreachable target): fix the network, DNS, the target's sshd or the authorized_keys entry of the deploy key, then request the deployment again.
